channel.title: The Shawnee News-Star - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Shawnee News-Star (news-star.com)

item.title: Meaningful voices at the Capitol
item.description: The Capitol has been filled this past week with meaningful legislation and thoughtful debate focused on what will best serve Oklahomans. We are still in the early stages of the legislative process.

item.title: (Calendar of events)
item.description: Calendar items may be sent to newsroom@news-star.com or to vicky.misa@news-star.com.

item.title: Harrah's hosts veteran's job fair in Shawnee
item.description: Harrah’s Oklahoma, a Caesars Entertainment casino opening this spring in Chandler, recently hosted a veteran’s job fair at Gordon Cooper Technology Center, connecting job seekers in the area with career opportunities.

item.title: Bison men hold off Southeastern Oklahoma State; OBU women fall
item.description: DURANT - The No. 9-ranked Oklahoma Baptist Bison pushed through for a tough, 63-59 win over Southeastern Oklahoma State on Saturday afternoon inside Bloomer Sullivan Arena.

item.title: Tulsa Booker T. Washington sweeps Shawnee on Senior Night
item.description: When good teams face off, the winner is often the team that controls how the game is played. Friday night, Booker T. Washington controlled the pace and style of play and took two wins from Shawnee on Senior Night.

item.title: Bison upend SWOSU in Monday play; OBU women knocked off
item.description: Nationally ranked Oklahoma Baptist shot 51.9% from the floor, had four players reach double figures and controlled the boards, particularly in the second half, in rolling to a 79-67 triumph over the Southwestern Oklahoma State Bulldogs Monday night in Great American Conference men’s basketball action at the Noble Complex. The OBU women fell to the SWOSU Bulldogs 56-51 in the earlier game Monday.

item.title: Shawnee basketball teams swept on the road by Collinsville
item.description: COLLINSVILLE – Shawnee Lady Wolves and Wolves closed out the regular season with road losses at Collinsville.

item.title: Asher girls blast Bowlegs; Asher boys upend Maud
item.description: MAUD - Asher picked up a pair of wins to see the Class B2 No. 5 Indians and No. 16 Lady Indians advance to Saturday’s Regional Championship games at Maud.

item.title: Dale girls, boys trounce Tuttle to celebrate Senior Night
item.description: DALE – It was clean sweep for the Dale Lady Pirates and Pirates on Senior Night as the teams took down Tuttle in easy fashion.

item.title: Pirates, Lady Pirates cruise to Monday victories at Cashion
item.description: CASHION – Senior Denton Forsythe fired in 34 points while draining four 3-point shots Monday night as the Class 2A top-ranked Dale Pirates drilled Cashion 87-48.
